intro: Zamael Lunthistle asks you to find his prayer to Elune, set down on a tablet of gold. One of the idol-worshipping scoundrels must carry it, and Zamael wants it taken to Astarii Starseeker in Darnassus.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Will you assist me, mortal? Will you find the prayer to Elune?
As I stated, the prayer was etched onto a golden tablet. One of these idol worshipping scoundrels must have it on their person.

If you do recover my prayer, take it to Astarii Starseeker in Darnassus. It matters little that my faith has been rekindled after the countless malevolent actions that I have taken against this world and its inhabitants, but my prayer must be heard. Absolution is the last thing I expect.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What brings you to the Temple of the Moon, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Elune smiles upon you this eve, friend. You have returned a lost soul to her. Please accept this as a token of our gratitude.
